title: 주흔 — 잊힌 이름
reference_role: Character identity only; premium anime reinterpretation

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape 16:9 polished anime supernatural action RPG title-screen concept, variant A, one single finished composition, not a contact sheet.
Primary request: create a stunning Japanese occult battle-anime title screen for the Korean game "주흔 — 잊힌 이름", with the dramatic supernatural sorcery atmosphere of Jujutsu Kaisen. This is a game concept, not an official franchise poster.
Reference image: the supplied local portrait is ONLY a character identity reference: tall spiky white hair, dark navy black blindfold, very high purple uniform collar, pale youthful adult male face. Reinterpret him as beautifully drawn premium hand-painted 2D anime key visual with mature proportions, rather than reproducing the low-poly render.
Composition: character in the right 55% in a dramatic large head-and-upper-torso three-quarter close-up, enough breathing room above his hair. His right hand rises in front of his collar with index and middle finger together in an elegant sorcery hand sign; correct natural anatomy. His black blindfold remains over his eyes; cyan supernatural light spills around its edge. An intent, restrained confident expression, not a broad grin.
Backdrop: the interior of an immense sealed spherical barrier, the architecture of a deserted Japanese temple corridor curving up into its vault, dark ink-like curse wisps and very faint faceless spirit silhouettes at the peripheral edges, loose paper talismans caught in supernatural wind, reflective black floor glimpsed at bottom. No identifiable antagonist and no kidnapped child shown. A thin cyan-violet ring of cursed energy sweeps behind the figure, with organic smoke, luminous fragments, ink splashes and beautiful painterly light instead of simple geometric VFX.
Palette: rich midnight indigo and black, electric cyan and violet rim light, a few tiny warm amber embers. Detailed line work, expressive shadows, cinematic contrast and generous quiet dark space on the left for readable typography, premium anime opening key-frame quality.
Typography is part of this PREVIEW MOCKUP: on the left, large beautifully rendered Korean brush-ink title exactly "주흔", with refined small subtitle exactly "잊힌 이름". Under the subtitle, subtle widely spaced small Korean menu lines exactly "새로운 이야기", "이어하기", "종료". One menu line is highlighted with a thin violet glow and a tiny talisman-shaped marker. Keep typography elegant and restrained, no large rectangles or modern sci-fi panels. These are Korean Hangul words; spell them accurately. The title should be the second focal point after the character.
Constraints: no English text, no other titles, no watermarks, no developer/company branding, no split panels, no repeated portraits, no extra hands, no excessive particles hiding the face. Maintain substantial empty margins and legible UI. Opaque background.

Huge sinister abstract ghost masks and fragmented ink spirits appear faintly within the far curved wall, as if countless erased memories are trapped there; do not identify any antagonist, do not show a child or torture. Above and behind the sorcerer a gorgeous irregular turquoise-violet energy fissure opens through the dark barrier, illuminating its curvature and the shrine architecture. No sun, no normal moon, no planet, no modern sci-fi city, no volcano. Clearly an occult sealed space, not an outdoor fantasy landscape.
Palette and finish: painterly premium 2D anime film background with crisp inked character edges, deep indigo/black, cyan-violet cursed-light reflections in the wet stones, very sparse vermilion gate accents and amber lanterns. Atmospheric depth, organic smoky curses, luminous fine dust, strong scale and beautiful controlled detail. Leftmost 35% remains quieter, darker and low contrast for typography while retaining distant architecture.
Typography is part of this PREVIEW MOCKUP: upper/middle left large dramatic white brush-ink Korean title exactly "주흔"; beneath it small elegant subtitle exactly "잊힌 이름". Lower left modest menu exactly "새로운 이야기", "이어하기", "종료". Subtle violet highlight under the first item, no menu boxes. Accurate Hangul spelling and clear readability. No English text and no other logos or branding.
Constraints: a single landscape scene, not a montage, not a split panel, no border, no watermark, no extra characters in the foreground, no repeated protagonist portraits. Character smaller and environment grander than a portrait-style title screen. Opaque background.

integration_notes: Text and menus are baked into these preview mockups only. Produce separate clean backgrounds and native Korean UI after concept selection. No opening cutscene, runtime behavior, or build output has changed.
